commit_message:
[Merged] [base64] Add FromBase64

This CL adds `Uint8Array.fromBase64()`.

Bug: 42204568
Change-Id: Ib68683a2d5ead9720077197c0f895787214b183e
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6026354
Commit-Queue: Rezvan Mahdavi Hezaveh <rezvan@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Shu-yu Guo <syg@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#98239}
pr_description:
Add Uint8Array.fromBase64() with base64/base64url alphabets and configurable last-chunk handling. Decode the input into temporary native storage while garbage collection is disallowed, then allocate and populate the JavaScript ArrayBuffer after the string's FlatContent scope ends. Preserve syntax-error and out-of-memory reporting.

Validation: the candidate diff applies cleanly against the parent revision, and git diff --check passes.

fix_commit_message:
[base64] Factor out AllowGC scope out of DisallowGC scope

This CL moves AllowGC scope out of DisallowGC scope to
make sure that FlatContent of the string is not moved
around by GC.

Bug: 421227542
Change-Id: I0653f0bc0cad1a1304abea23b9ac19f3937fbfa5
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6614257
Reviewed-by: Leszek Swirski <leszeks@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Rezvan Mahdavi Hezaveh <rezvan@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#100655}
agent_reasoning: Allocating the JavaScript ArrayBuffer inside the decoding helper would require allowing garbage collection while the caller still holds String::FlatContent under DisallowGarbageCollection. Collection could move the underlying string and violate FlatContent's lifetime invariant. The helper now returns native decoded storage and reports the decode result and output length; JavaScript allocation and copying happen only after FlatContent and its no-GC scope have ended. The edits retain the snapshot's Handle APIs and option variables while applying the supplied decoding and allocation changes.
